payload.ranking_principle: public screening scores are a cheap map for selecting a dynamic rapid-triage candidate pool and must never directly promote a company to a formal profile, deep research, underwriting or buy_now
payload.research_value_principle: allocate the next research hour where it is most likely to change a portfolio decision; uncertainty that is expensive or unresolvable lowers priority
payload.stop_principle: a stop is an auditable research-capital decision, not a permanent investment verdict; every non-structural stop requires a reactivation trigger
payload.comparison_principle: formal-profile capacity is allocated only after the complete rapid-triage cohort is sealed and compared cross-sectionally; completion order must not affect promotion
